articles.summary: Publication marks the first time in nearly two decades that The New England Journal of Medicine has published clinical data on standalone real-time continuous glucose monitoring (CGM) technology, dating back to the creation of the CGM category. Randomized controlled trial demonstrates Dexcom G7 significantly reduces A1C and improves glucose control compared with routine care. Benefits observed across a broad range of participants, including those taking GLP-1 medications.1 Findings support the role of CGM earlier in Type 2 diabetes care for all people, including those over the age of 65. DexCom, Inc. (NASDAQ: DXCM), the global leader in glucose biosensing, today announced that results from the landmark CONNECT randomized controlled trial have been published in The New England Journal of Medicine (NEJM), providing rigorous evidence of the significant benefits of continuous glucose monitoring (CGM) for adults with Type 2 diabetes not on insulin. articles.summary: The longest-lasting and most accurate1 continuous glucose monitoring (CGM) system authorized by Health Canada will offer people living with diabetes over the age of 18 up to 15.5 days of wear with fewer sensor changes.2 Dexcom G7 15 Day will be publicly reimbursed for many eligible Canadians living with diabetes beginning in November. Private health plans that cover CGMs will be adding coverage for Dexcom G7 15 Day in November. DexCom, Inc. (NASDAQ: DXCM), the global leader in glucose biosensing, announced today that the Dexcom G7 15 Day Continuous Glucose Monitoring System (CGM) will be available in Canada beginning next month for adults 18 years and older living with diabetes. Offering up to 15.5 days of wear, 2 Dexcom G7 15 Day combines industry leading sensor duration with best-in-class accuracy, 1 giving Canadians living with diabetes more time between sensor changes and fewer interruptions to daily routines. articles.summary: DexCom, Inc. (NASDAQ:DXCM) today announced that it plans to release its third quarter 2026 financial results after market close on Thursday, October 29, 2026. Management will hold a conference call to review the company's third quarter 2026 performance starting at 4:30 p.m. (Eastern Time) on the same day. The conference call will be concurrently webcast. The link to the webcast will be available on the Dexcom investor relations website at investors.dexcom.com and will be archived there for future reference. To listen to the conference call, please dial (888) 414-4585 (US/Canada) or (646) 960-0331 (International) and use the confirmation ID "9430114" approximately five minutes prior to the start time. articles.summary: DexCom, Inc. (Nasdaq: DXCM) today reported its financial results as of and for the quarter ended September 30, 2026. Third Quarter 2026 Financial Highlights: Revenue grew 11% year-over-year to $1.344 billion on a reported basis and 11% year-over-year on an organic 1 basis. U.S. revenue grew 14% and international revenue grew 5% on a reported basis and 5% on an organic 1 basis, all on a year-over-year basis. GAAP operating income of $327.2 million or 24.3% of revenue, an increase of 420 basis points compared to the third quarter of 2025. Non-GAAP operating income* of $339.5 million or 25.3% of reported revenue, an increase of 270 basis points compared to the third quarter of 2025.
